_comment: A POS terminal's link to the host, as a PayProbe connection. The terminal is the CLIENT (mode outbound: the worker dials host:port). The wire framing is the preset 'ascii4' — a 4-character ASCII-decimal length counting only the body — which is what terminal test tools print as the link-level string 'CHARDEC:false:false:BIG:4:' (paste that into framing.link_level instead if you prefer). The dialect is bound ON THE CONNECTION (message_format_id): the reader decodes every reply on the socket with the format's field table and wire encoding, so a dialect with non-standard lengths (3-digit DE 39 here) must be bound here, not only on a step. Replace host/port with your processing host.

pos_terminal_link.description: POS terminal → host link (ASCII ISO 8583, 4-digit ASCII length prefix)

pos_terminal_link_stx_etx.description: Same dialect over a serial-style STX/ETX/LRC envelope (no length prefix)
